messages:
emma_w: Quick sync — we need a telemetry + CI plan for the refarch Terraform modules before marketplace submission. target: EOD Fri.

jordan: Do we mean module-level telemetry (prometheus/exporter) or the reference arch deployment dashboards?

sanjay_r: Both. Module should expose metrics (success_count, error_count, apply_duration) via a tiny exporter container. Refarch repo should have a sample grafana dashboard + instructions.

lia: For marketplace we also need deterministic outputs and test fixtures so automated smoke tests can assert resources. add `outputs.tf` with stable names.

emma_w: Agreed. Proposal: (1) terraform module metrics interface, (2) a sample k8s manifest for an exporter, (3) a dashboard JSON + readme, (4) CI jobs that run `terraform init/plan` + smoke apply in ephemeral acct.

jordan: For CI, can we reuse existing infra-onramp runners? I can add a job: `validate-refarch` that spins up ephemeral cluster via kind + localstack for cloud calls.

ci-bot: ci/build #237 failed on marketplace-refarch: unit tests missing for `networking` module. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-refarchs/actions/runs/987654321

sanjay_r: I'll take networking tests. plan to add a tiny local exporter: `cmd/telemetry-exporter` that reads env and exposes /metrics. snippet for module consumers: 
```hcl
module "vpc" {
  source = "./modules/vpc"
  enable_telemetry = true
}
```

lia: Dashboard should include: ingress latency, p95 response time, apply_duration histogram, and a small alerts page for >5% error rate over 10m. attach sample JSON to the refarch repo.

emma_w: Can someone draft the README sections? I want a short checklist in the PR body: telemetry, dashboard, smoke-ci, outputs, LICENSE.

alex_pm: I'll write the marketplace notes (security + telemetry section) once PR lands. linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-refarchs/pull/42

jordan: Ownerships: sanjay -> exporter + tests, lia -> outputs + dashboard, me -> CI job, emma -> final PR review. I'll open PR drafts by EOD tomorrow.

emma_w: sweet. if you hit blockers ping me or @alex_pm. :rocket:

ci-bot: Reminder: please add integration test tags so runners pick up only refarch suites (tag: refarch).
